header.act: ACT III — THE LINE OF THE TISZA
player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Béla Szántó
line.reaction-briliant.text: The Romanians expected a rout and found a front. Budapest has stopped drafting evacuation orders.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Béla Szántó
line.reaction-tactical.text: We are on the Tisza because there was nowhere further to fall back to. The Council is asking questions this army cannot yet answer.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Béla Szántó
line.reaction-victory.text: We hold the Tisza. The government will call it a victory; the staff will call it a reprieve.
line.callback-rearguard-held.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.callback-rearguard-held.text: The rear guard held Hajduboszormeny to the last hour. The transport columns crossed the Tisza intact because of it.
line.callback-core-intact.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.callback-core-intact.text: Not one formation was lost in the withdrawal. The staff has been recalculating what this army can still be asked to do.
line.may-day-river.speaker: Béla Szántó
line.may-day-river.text: Budapest has dressed its boulevards in red for May Day. Here the banners are strips of cloth marking batteries in the river mist. The capital celebrates a workers' state while Romanian patrols test the bridges that lead to it.
line.bohm-line.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-line.text: The retreat ends at the Tisza because beyond it lies Budapest. A Romanian vanguard is already across near Szolnok; engineers are measuring the bank for more bridges. If that bridgehead widens, the river ceases to be a defence and becomes a road into the capital.
line.stromfeld-plan.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-plan.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-plan.text: First secure the western bank, the bridge and the depots. Then decide how much risk we take east of the river. Where does the mobile reserve wait: behind the crossings, or across them where it can seize the initiative before Romanian reinforcements arrive?
Keep it west of the river to crush any breakthrough and protect the bridge and supply depots.
Gain an entrenched infantry detachment and a smaller prestige award, but forgo the larger prestige and core-wide experience of the eastern bridgehead.
Send it across early and expand our own bridgehead before Romanian reinforcements arrive.
Gain a larger prestige award and experience for every core formation, but forgo the additional entrenched infantry detachment.
line.szanto-west.speaker: Béla Szántó
line.szanto-west.text: A secure western bank protects the state, but the enemy must not be allowed to deploy artillery unopposed across the river. Prepare a local counterattack once the line is stable.
line.stromfeld-east.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-east.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-east.text: An eastern bridgehead may seize the initiative, but feed units across only while the crossing is protected. Do not let enthusiasm strand the best formations beyond the river.
line.bohm-final.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-final.text: At Szolnok we stop improvising. Hold the bridge, depots and command post. Every battalion must know where its ammunition comes from and where the reserve waits.
